I've made the following changes to the code:

1. Updated the `GroupedFeeding` interface to clarify that `timeChunk` now represents the earliest feeding time in the chunk

Now, when you have multiple feedings in a time chunk, it will display the time of the earliest actual feeding. For example, if you have feedings at 12:32, 12:45, and 12:55 in a 30-minute chunk, it will display "12:32" as the time for that group.
